items.title: US Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Rebound On Stubborn Inflation Higher-For-Longer Risk
items.summary: The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Wednesday, Nov, 11 2026 US equities are set for a cautious but firmer open, with sentiment driven almost entirely by another hot inflation print. Investors are reading the rebound in futures as a reluctant embrace of higher for longer rates. The October CPI report showed headline prices up 0.4% month on month and core inflation at 0.3%. Those figures, alongside hawkish recent Fed comments, keep a December move of at least 25 bp firmly on the table...
